questions.question_text: Which of the following steps is required to enable encryption for both the OS and data disks when creating a new Azure virtual machine?

options.label: A
options.text: Select "Enable encryption" checkbox in the Basics tab

options.label: B
options.text: Use Azure Disk Encryption with a customer-managed key for OS and data disks

options.label: C
options.text: Apply Azure Storage Service Encryption after deployment

options.label: D
options.text: Use a managed identity for the VM

questions.explanation: Encryption must be enabled during creation using Azure Disk Encryption with a customer-managed key; the portal checkbox alone does not cover both OS and data disks.

questions.question_text: You need to deploy a virtual machine that will host a database requiring 8 vCPUs and 64 GB of RAM. Which VM size should you choose?

options.label: A
options.text: Standard_D2s_v3

options.label: B
options.text: Standard_E8s_v3

options.label: C
options.text: Standard_D4s_v3

options.label: D
options.text: Standard_D8s_v3

questions.explanation: The E8s_v3 size provides 8 vCPUs and 64 GB memory, matching the required resources.

questions.question_text: How can you move an existing virtual machine to a different resource group while preserving its disk encryption settings?

options.label: A
options.text: Use the 'Move' blade in the Azure portal

options.label: B
options.text: Recreate the VM in the new resource group

options.label: C
options.text: Use the Azure CLI az vm move command

options.label: D
options.text: Deploy a new ARM template

questions.explanation: The portal's 'Move' blade allows moving a VM to another resource group while preserving its configuration, including disk encryption settings.

questions.question_text: After creating a VM, you want to attach a data disk and enable encryption for that disk. Which option should you use?

options.label: A
options.text: Use Azure Disk Encryption in the portal

options.label: B
options.text: Enable Storage Service Encryption on the storage account

options.label: C
options.text: Use Azure AD Conditional Access

options.label: D
options.text: Configure a VM Scale Set

questions.explanation: Azure Disk Encryption can be applied to a data disk after it's attached, using the encryption settings in the VM creation or update process.

questions.question_text: In a region that supports Availability Zones, what is the default zone for a newly created virtual machine?

options.label: A
options.text: Zone 1

options.label: B
options.text: Zone 2

options.label: C
options.text: Zone 3

options.label: D
options.text: No zone (regional)

questions.explanation: When Availability Zones are enabled, the default placement is Zone 1 unless otherwise specified.

questions.question_text: To create a VM Scale Set with three instances and enable automatic scaling based on CPU usage, which Azure CLI command includes the necessary parameters?

options.label: A
options.text: az vmss create --name myVMSS --instance-count 3

options.label: B
options.text: az vmss create --name myVMSS --instance-count 1

options.label: C
options.text: az vmss create --name myVMSS --instance-count 5

options.label: D
options.text: az vmss create --name myVMSS --instance-count 0

questions.explanation: The instance-count parameter in az vmss create sets the number of VM instances; the command in option A sets it to 3.

questions.question_text: What is the recommended approach for selecting the appropriate VM size to balance cost and performance?

options.label: A
options.text: Choose the largest VM size available

options.label: B
options.text: Use Azure Advisor recommendations

options.label: C
options.text: Hardcode the size in your deployment script

options.label: D
options.text: Use the default size for the selected image

questions.explanation: Azure Advisor analyzes your workload and suggests the optimal VM size for cost and performance.

questions.question_text: When you delete a virtual machine (not deallocate) in Azure, what happens to its OS disk?

options.label: A
options.text: The OS disk is retained and can be reattached

options.label: B
options.text: The OS disk is automatically deleted

options.label: C
options.text: The OS disk is converted to a snapshot

options.label: D
options.text: The OS disk is moved to the resource group's default storage account

questions.explanation: Deleting a VM (not deallocating) removes the associated OS disk unless you explicitly choose to keep it.

questions.question_text: Which method enables encryption of a premium SSD data disk attached to a VM?

options.label: A
options.text: Use Azure Disk Encryption with a platform-managed key

options.label: B
options.text: Use Azure Disk Encryption with a customer-managed key

options.label: C
options.text: Use Azure Storage Service Encryption

options.label: D
options.text: Use a VMSS to apply encryption

questions.explanation: Customer-managed keys allow you to control encryption keys for premium SSD data disks via Azure Disk Encryption.

questions.question_text: What is the primary purpose of the 'Provisioned IOPS' SKU for Azure managed disks?

options.label: A
options.text: To provide a fixed amount of IOPS for predictable performance

options.label: B
options.text: To automatically compress stored data

options.label: C
options.text: To enable encryption at rest

options.label: D
options.text: To support virtual machine scale sets

questions.explanation: Provisioned IOPS SKU lets you specify a guaranteed level of IOPS, providing predictable performance for demanding workloads.
